candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Intern (all genders) – Global Markets Data & AI Lab
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship in the Global Markets Data & AI Lab. Extracting usable data from text, classifying behaviour and building machine learning models in PyTorch and scikit-learn is the kind of work I have done in my projects, and I would like to apply it to financial markets.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I also bring industry experience with business data from SAP analytics roles.

achievements.impact: in a team project I extracted subject-relation-object triples from Reddit text with spaCy and compared graph-based and BERT/GPT-2 embeddings for clustering
I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 in PyTorch that reached 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set
I built DocuMind, a RAG system that answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly, with hybrid retrieval raising MRR from 0.748 to 0.898

letter.problems_section: I would gather and clean data, build and evaluate models for classification and prediction, and apply NLP to text sources. I am new to capital markets, so I would learn the domain from your team while contributing solid Python and modelling skills.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Frankfurt and can start immediately, part-time during the semester. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length and hours with you so they fit my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
